caption:
Bob just wanted to say it's hot on the bus 🥵🐜 …she took it the other way 😳

"I'm so hot" can sound like "I'm sexy". Say "It's so hot today!" or "I'm boiling!" instead.

Be honest, have you said it like Bob? 👇 Save it for summer 📌

#learnenglish #englishtips #speakenglish #aivideo #london
